senses.en: a law passed by a parliament or congress
senses.pattern: pass an act / an Act of Parliament / under the act
senses.example: Under the new [[act]], factories that pollute rivers will have to pay much heavier fines.
senses.example_zh: 根據這項新法案，汙染河川的工廠將必須繳納更重的罰款。
senses.note: 作法案名稱時常大寫：the Clean Air Act

senses.en: to have an effect on something
senses.pattern: act quickly / act on the brain / act on the nervous system
senses.example: The painkiller [[acts]] quickly, so most patients feel better within twenty minutes of taking it.
senses.example_zh: 這種止痛藥很快就起作用，大多數病人服用後二十分鐘內就覺得好多了。

senses.en: one of the main parts of a play
senses.pattern: Act One / the final act / a play in three acts
senses.example: The hero does not appear on stage until the second [[act]] of the play.
senses.example_zh: 主角直到這齣戲的第二幕才登場。

gsat.sentence: The earliest reference to these documents is found in a 15th-century [[Act]] of Parliament, while the term “passport” came into use about a century later.

senses.en: different from the usual or traditional kind
senses.pattern: alternative medicine / alternative music / an alternative lifestyle
senses.example: Tired of taking pills, she turned to [[alternative]] medicine such as acupuncture and herbal tea.
senses.example_zh: 她厭倦了吃藥，轉而求助針灸、花草茶等另類療法。

gsat.sentence: Since the 1990s, [[alternative]] proms have been organized in some areas to meet the needs of particular students.
According to the passage, what gave rise to [[alternative]] proms?

senses.en: a sudden short period of illness
senses.pattern: a heart attack / an asthma attack / a panic attack
senses.example: He always carries an inhaler in case he has an asthma [[attack]] during PE class.
senses.example_zh: 他總是隨身帶著吸入器，以防體育課時氣喘發作。

senses.en: to criticize someone or something strongly
senses.pattern: attack a policy / attack a decision / be attacked for
senses.example: Several newspapers [[attacked]] the plan to cut down the old trees in the city park.
senses.example_zh: 數家報紙抨擊砍掉市立公園老樹的計畫。

gsat.sentence: The craze for hoops even resulted in dislocated backs and heart [[attacks]], according to medical records.
Conversely, worry can give a person an <u>ulcer</u>, high blood pressure, or even a heart [[attack]].

senses.en: the bottom of a river, lake, or sea
senses.pattern: a dry river bed / the sea bed / the bed of the lake
senses.example: After months without rain, the river [[bed]] was completely dry and covered with cracks.
senses.example_zh: 幾個月沒下雨，河床完全乾涸，布滿了裂痕。

senses.en: an area of ground for growing plants
senses.pattern: a flower bed / a vegetable bed / a rose bed
senses.example: Grandpa spent the whole afternoon planting tulips in the flower [[bed]] beside the gate.
senses.example_zh: 爺爺花了整個下午在大門旁的花圃裡種鬱金香。

senses.en: to make the effort to do something
senses.pattern: not bother to do / not bother doing / Why bother? / Don't bother.
senses.example: Most visitors don't [[bother]] to read the long instructions posted at the entrance of the museum.
senses.example_zh: 大多數遊客都不會費心去讀博物館入口張貼的那一長串說明。
senses.note: 多用於否定句和疑問句

senses.en: something that causes worry or anxiety
senses.pattern: without a care in the world / the cares of daily life / free from care
senses.example: Lying on the beach, he felt as if all his [[cares]] had been washed away by the waves.
senses.example_zh: 躺在沙灘上，他覺得所有的煩惱彷彿都被海浪沖走了。

senses.en: to like or want something (formal)
senses.pattern: Would you care for…? / care to join us / care to comment
senses.example: Would you [[care]] for another cup of tea while you wait for the manager?
senses.example_zh: 等經理的時候，您想要再來一杯茶嗎？
senses.note: 用於客氣的詢問或否定句

senses.en: most important; highest in rank
senses.pattern: the chief cause / the chief reason / chief concern / chief engineer
senses.example: Lack of sleep is the [[chief]] cause of poor concentration among teenagers, the report says.
senses.example_zh: 報告指出，睡眠不足是青少年注意力不集中的主要原因。

gsat.sentence: Showing great talent in painting, Moran was soon hired as an illustrator at Scribner’s Monthly, and later appointed [[chief]] illustrator by age 34.
Seeing this, Brahma, the [[chief]] god, decided to take their divinity away from them and hide it where it could never be found.

senses.en: to search a place or thing very carefully
senses.pattern: comb the area / comb the woods for clues / comb through the records
senses.example: Volunteers [[combed]] the beach for hours, looking for the ring she had dropped in the sand.
senses.example_zh: 志工在海灘上仔細搜尋了好幾個小時，想找到她掉在沙裡的戒指。
senses.note: 字尾 b 不發音；comb through＝仔細查閱

senses.en: kindness and care for other people's feelings
senses.pattern: show consideration for others / out of consideration for / lack of consideration
senses.example: Please show some [[consideration]] for your neighbors and turn the music down after ten.
senses.example_zh: 請體諒一下鄰居，十點以後把音樂關小聲。

senses.en: a fact to think about when deciding something
senses.pattern: an important consideration / financial considerations / safety considerations
senses.example: For most families choosing a school, distance from home is an important [[consideration]].
senses.example_zh: 對大多數選學校的家庭而言，離家遠近是重要的考量因素。

gsat.sentence: Out of courtesy and [[consideration]], I always write a thank-you note when someone sends me a gift.

senses.en: to solve a difficult problem or break a code
senses.pattern: crack a code / crack a case / crack the problem
senses.example: It took the detective three months to [[crack]] the case of the stolen painting.
senses.example_zh: 那位偵探花了三個月才偵破這起名畫失竊案。

senses.en: to lose control because of great pressure
senses.pattern: crack under pressure / crack under the strain / finally crack
senses.example: Some students [[crack]] under the pressure of exams, so schools now offer free counseling.
senses.example_zh: 有些學生在考試壓力下崩潰，因此學校現在提供免費諮商。

senses.en: money paid first as a guarantee or part payment
senses.pattern: pay a deposit / a security deposit / put down a deposit / get the deposit back
senses.example: The landlord kept our [[deposit]] because we had left stains all over the carpet.
senses.example_zh: 因為我們把地毯弄得到處是汙漬，房東沒收了我們的押金。

senses.en: a natural layer of a mineral or other substance
senses.pattern: mineral deposits / oil deposits / rich deposits of gold
senses.example: Rich [[deposits]] of copper were discovered in these mountains a hundred years ago.
senses.example_zh: 一百年前，人們在這些山區發現了豐富的銅礦藏。

senses.en: to attract people or their attention or interest
senses.pattern: draw a crowd / draw attention to / be drawn to
senses.example: The night market [[draws]] thousands of tourists every weekend with its cheap and tasty snacks.
senses.example_zh: 這個夜市以便宜又美味的小吃，每個週末吸引數千名觀光客。
senses.note: 名詞 draw 另指「平手；抽籤」

senses.en: to reach a conclusion or idea after thinking
senses.pattern: draw a conclusion / draw a lesson from / draw a comparison
senses.example: It is too early to [[draw]] any conclusions from a survey of only twenty people.
senses.example_zh: 只調查了二十個人，現在要得出任何結論還太早。

gsat.sentence: People may choose a name because they are strongly [[drawn]] to a character in a book or a television series; they may also adopt names of famous people or their favorite actors and actresses.
What is the most significant implication that teachers can [[draw]] from the above information? They should

senses.en: to continue to exist for a long time
senses.pattern: endure for centuries / endure to this day / an enduring friendship
senses.example: The tradition of giving red envelopes to children has [[endured]] for hundreds of years.
senses.example_zh: 發紅包給小孩的傳統已經持續了數百年。

gsat.sentence: The belief that rapid speech and lying go together is also widespread and [[enduring]].
Exposure of one’s inner thoughts is essential for [[enduring]] relationships.

senses.en: a natural ability to do something easily
senses.pattern: a facility for languages / a facility with words / great facility
senses.example: Having grown up in three countries, Mia has an amazing [[facility]] for learning languages.
senses.example_zh: 米亞在三個國家長大，有驚人的語言學習天賦。
senses.note: 此義常用單數，後接 for 或 with

senses.en: a valuable or interesting thing or person discovered
senses.pattern: a real find / an important find / archaeological finds
senses.example: The ancient coins dug up near the temple were the most exciting [[find]] of the year.
senses.example_zh: 在廟宇附近挖出的古錢幣是今年最令人振奮的發現。

senses.en: (of a court) to decide officially that someone is guilty or not
senses.pattern: find someone guilty / find someone not guilty / be found guilty of theft
senses.example: After a two-week trial, the court [[found]] the company guilty of polluting the river.
senses.example_zh: 經過兩週的審理，法院判定該公司汙染河川罪名成立。

senses.en: without something unwanted or harmful
senses.pattern: free of chemicals / free from pain / free from worry / sugar-free
senses.example: Farmers here grow vegetables that are completely [[free]] of chemical fertilizers and pesticides.
senses.example_zh: 這裡的農夫種植完全不含化學肥料和農藥的蔬菜。

senses.en: to release someone, or remove something unpleasant from them
senses.pattern: free a prisoner / free someone from / free up time
senses.example: The robot vacuum [[frees]] busy parents from the daily chore of sweeping the floor.
senses.example_zh: 掃地機器人使忙碌的父母擺脫每天掃地的家務。

gsat.sentence: It must be [[free]] from impurity, while exhibiting some fruitiness and creating a pleasant bitter flavor along with a peppery sensation in the mouth.
We naively believe that somehow we are [[free]] from the problems our parents had.

senses.en: young and lacking experience
senses.pattern: still green / a green recruit / too green for the job
senses.example: The coach knew the players were still [[green]], so he arranged extra practice games for them.
senses.example_zh: 教練知道這些球員還很生嫩，所以替他們多安排了幾場練習賽。

senses.en: not harmful to the environment
senses.pattern: green energy / green products / go green / green buildings
senses.example: The school went [[green]] by installing solar panels and banning plastic bottles on campus.
senses.example_zh: 這所學校裝設太陽能板並禁止校園內使用塑膠瓶，走向環保。

gsat.sentence: Greatly concerned about the presence of fake “[[green]]” products on the market, Alice Bao decided to open this shop.
Then, a local [[green]] energy startup company got the idea to turn that waste into energy.

senses.en: known by almost everyone
senses.pattern: a household name / a household word / become a household name
senses.example: The young baker became a [[household]] name after winning a popular television cooking contest.
senses.example_zh: 這位年輕烘焙師贏得熱門電視烹飪比賽後，成了家喻戶曉的人物。
senses.note: 只放名詞前，最常見 a household name

senses.en: fair and morally right
senses.pattern: a just society / a just cause / a just decision / a just reward
senses.example: Most villagers agreed that the fine was a [[just]] punishment for dumping waste into the river.
senses.example_zh: 大多數村民都認為，這筆罰款是對往河裡傾倒廢棄物的公正懲罰。
senses.note: 名詞 justice＝正義；反義 unjust

senses.en: to completely flatten or destroy buildings or an area
senses.pattern: level a building / level the town / level the ground
senses.example: The powerful typhoon [[leveled]] hundreds of wooden houses along the coast in a single night.
senses.example_zh: 強烈颱風一夜之間把沿岸數百棟木屋夷為平地。
senses.note: 英式拼法過去式為 levelled

senses.en: flat; at the same height as something else
senses.pattern: level ground / a level surface / level with the window / a level teaspoon
senses.example: Make sure the ground is [[level]] before you set up the tent for the night.
senses.example_zh: 晚上搭帳篷之前，要先確定地面是平坦的。

senses.en: to walk in step, or walk together in protest
senses.pattern: march through the streets / march for peace / march against the war / a marching band
senses.example: Thousands of students [[marched]] through the capital to demand stronger action on climate change.
senses.example_zh: 數千名學生在首都遊行示威，要求對氣候變遷採取更有力的行動。

senses.en: the steady forward progress of something
senses.pattern: the march of time / the march of progress / the march of technology
senses.example: No one can stop the [[march]] of time, but we can decide how to spend each day.
senses.example_zh: 沒有人能阻止時間的推進，但我們可以決定如何度過每一天。

gsat.sentence: Finally, football fans seem to love the half-time activities, the [[marching]] bands, and the pretty cheerleaders.
Then, almost as if at a given signal, the group begins to [[march]] toward the colony to be raided.

senses.en: to wrongly think one thing is another
senses.pattern: mistake A for B / mistake salt for sugar / be mistaken for
senses.example: In the fog, the hikers [[mistook]] a large rock for a bear and ran away.
senses.example_zh: 在霧中，那些登山客把一塊大石頭誤認為熊，拔腿就跑。

gsat.sentence: I [[mistook]] the man for a well-known actor and asked for his autograph; it was really embarrassing.

senses.en: a special ability to find or recognize something
senses.pattern: a nose for news / a nose for a bargain / have a good nose for business
senses.example: With her [[nose]] for a good story, the reporter was the first to notice the strange pattern.
senses.example_zh: 憑著發掘好故事的敏銳直覺，那位記者最先注意到這個奇怪的規律。
senses.note: 常用 have a nose for＋名詞

senses.en: the front part of a plane or vehicle
senses.pattern: the nose of the plane / the nose of the rocket / the plane's nose
senses.example: The pilot slowly lifted the [[nose]] of the plane, and it rose smoothly into the air.
senses.example_zh: 飛行員慢慢拉起機頭，飛機便平穩地升空。

senses.en: training given before starting a new school or job
senses.pattern: freshman orientation / an orientation program / orientation week / attend an orientation
senses.example: During [[orientation]], new employees are shown around the office and introduced to their team leaders.
senses.example_zh: 在新進人員訓練期間，會有人帶新員工參觀辦公室，並介紹他們認識組長。

senses.en: the main interests, aims, or beliefs of a person or group
senses.pattern: a practical orientation / a political orientation / a strong customer orientation
senses.example: The course has a practical [[orientation]], with more lab work than lectures.
senses.example_zh: 這門課是實務取向，實驗課比講課還多。

senses.en: to bring an advantage or be worth doing
senses.pattern: It pays to be careful. / Honesty pays. / Crime doesn't pay.
senses.example: It [[pays]] to compare prices at several stores before you buy an expensive camera.
senses.example_zh: 買昂貴的相機之前，先多比較幾家店的價格是有好處的。

senses.en: money received for doing work
senses.pattern: low pay / a pay raise / equal pay / sick pay
senses.example: The nurses are asking for better [[pay]] and shorter working hours.
senses.example_zh: 護理師們要求提高薪水並縮短工時。

senses.en: to suffer because of something you did
senses.pattern: pay for one's mistakes / pay dearly for / make someone pay
senses.example: He stayed up playing games every night and [[paid]] for it with terrible exam results.
senses.example_zh: 他每晚熬夜打電動，結果付出代價，考試成績慘不忍睹。

gsat.sentence: Those college students work at the orphanage on a voluntary basis, helping the children with their studies without receiving any [[pay]].

senses.en: to make someone happy or satisfied
senses.pattern: hard to please / eager to please / please everyone
senses.example: No matter how hard the chef tried, he could not [[please]] the picky customer at table five.
senses.example_zh: 不管廚師多努力，就是無法使五號桌那位挑剔的客人滿意。

senses.en: to want, like, or choose to do something
senses.pattern: as you please / do as one pleases / whatever you please
senses.example: During the summer camp, children can swim, paint, or read as they [[please]] in the afternoon.
senses.example_zh: 夏令營期間，孩子們下午想要游泳、畫畫還是看書都可以。

gsat.sentence: Those who have an inclination for crazy technological advances aren’t hard to [[please]].

senses.en: fairly; to quite a large degree
senses.pattern: pretty good / pretty sure / pretty hard / pretty much
senses.example: The math test was [[pretty]] hard, but most of us managed to finish it in time.
senses.example_zh: 這次數學考試相當難，但我們大多數人都及時寫完了。
senses.note: 口語用法，修飾形容詞或副詞

gsat.sentence: When he returned, he felt “[[pretty]] good.”
This bark can be [[pretty]] thick, well over two feet in the more mature trees.

senses.en: the small black circle in the center of the eye
senses.pattern: dilated pupils / the pupil of the eye / pupils widen / pupils shrink
senses.example: The eye doctor put in special drops to make my [[pupils]] larger before the examination.
senses.example_zh: 眼科醫師在檢查前幫我點了特殊的藥水，讓瞳孔放大。

senses.en: the act of mentioning someone or something
senses.pattern: make reference to / a reference to / make no reference to / with reference to
senses.example: In her speech, the principal made no [[reference]] to the rumor about closing the library.
senses.example_zh: 校長在致詞中完全沒有提及關閉圖書館的傳聞。

senses.en: a letter about your character, or the person writing it
senses.pattern: write a reference / ask for a reference / a job reference / list someone as a reference
senses.example: My former teacher kindly agreed to write a [[reference]] for my scholarship application.
senses.example_zh: 我以前的老師很好心地答應為我的獎學金申請寫推薦信。

gsat.sentence: In fact, there is documented [[reference]] to the ringing of bells even before the cathedral’s construction was completed, dating as far back as the 12th century.
In the Old Testament, [[reference]] is made to spiral staircases in the Temple of Solomon, suggesting that they were already in use by around 1,000 BC.

senses.en: to correct a wrong, or put something upright again
senses.pattern: right a wrong / right an injustice / right the boat / right itself
senses.example: The company tried to [[right]] the wrong by giving every customer a full refund.
senses.example_zh: 那家公司試圖糾正錯誤，全額退費給每一位顧客。

senses.en: exactly; all the way
senses.pattern: right in the middle / right after class / right through the night / right to the end
senses.example: The ball landed [[right]] in the middle of the pond, and nobody wanted to get it.
senses.example_zh: 球正好落在池塘正中央，沒有人想去撿。
senses.note: 放在介系詞或副詞前加強語氣

gsat.sentence: After centuries of technological advancements, it seems we’ve ended up [[right]] where we began in ancient times: with ourselves in the middle, and our destinations at the top.
As tea became much cheaper during the nineteenth century, its popularity spread [[right]] through all corners of the British society.

senses.en: twenty; in the plural, a large number
senses.pattern: scores of people / scores of fans / scores of letters
senses.example: [[Scores]] of volunteers showed up to clean the beach after the oil spill.
senses.example_zh: 漏油事件後，大批志工前來清理海灘。

senses.en: written music, or the music for a film
senses.pattern: a film score / a musical score / read a score / compose the score
senses.example: The composer spent two years writing the [[score]] for the animated film.
senses.example_zh: 那位作曲家花了兩年為這部動畫電影寫配樂。

senses.en: to strongly influence how something develops
senses.pattern: shape one's character / shape the future / shape public opinion / be shaped by
senses.example: The years she spent in a small fishing village [[shaped]] her view of nature.
senses.example_zh: 她在小漁村度過的歲月塑造了她的自然觀。

senses.en: the physical condition of someone or something
senses.pattern: in good shape / in bad shape / stay in shape / out of shape
senses.example: My grandfather stays in good [[shape]] by swimming for an hour every morning.
senses.example_zh: 我爺爺每天早上游泳一小時，保持良好的健康狀況。

gsat.sentence: Meanwhile, environmental influences seem to [[shape]] a person’s synesthesia. For example, the flavors people with taste-word synesthesia experience are usually childhood flavors, such as chocolate or strawberries.
More than one-third are in such bad [[shape]] that they could die within ten years.

senses.en: a share or part of something
senses.pattern: a slice of the market / a slice of the profits / a large slice of the budget
senses.example: Online shops now take a large [[slice]] of the market once controlled by department stores.
senses.example_zh: 網路商店如今占去了過去由百貨公司掌控的一大部分市場。
senses.note: a slice of life＝生活的片段、寫照

senses.en: the ability to speak, or the way someone speaks
senses.pattern: lose the power of speech / slow speech / a speech problem / speech and writing
senses.example: The stroke affected her [[speech]], so she now communicates mostly by writing notes.
senses.example_zh: 中風影響了她的說話能力，所以她現在大多靠寫字條溝通。

gsat.sentence: Silence in some way is as expressive as [[speech]]. It can be used to show, for example, disagreement or lack of interest.
Rapid [[speech]] without mistakes is a reliable sign of intelligence.

senses.en: excitement, interest, or shock felt by many people
senses.pattern: cause a stir / create a stir / quite a stir
senses.example: The discovery of a rare white deer created a [[stir]] in the quiet mountain town.
senses.example_zh: 發現一頭罕見白鹿的消息在這個寧靜的山城引起轟動。

senses.en: to make someone feel a strong emotion
senses.pattern: stir memories / stir the imagination / stir up anger / be deeply stirred
senses.example: The old photographs [[stirred]] memories of the summers we spent on our grandmother's farm.
senses.example_zh: 這些老照片激起了我們對外婆農場那些夏日時光的回憶。

senses.en: to show or indicate that something is probably true
senses.pattern: evidence suggests that / studies suggest that / the results suggest / as the name suggests
senses.example: The footprints in the mud [[suggest]] that a large animal passed by the camp last night.
senses.example_zh: 泥地上的腳印顯示，昨晚有大型動物經過營地。
senses.note: 此義的 that 子句不用（should）＋原形

gsat.sentence: This [[suggests]] that napping may significantly delay age-related brain shrinkage, and thus lower the possibility of developing dementia.
In the Old Testament, reference is made to spiral staircases in the Temple of Solomon, [[suggesting]] that they were already in use by around 1,000 BC.

senses.en: to move somewhere very quickly
senses.pattern: tear down the street / tear along the road / tear out of the room
senses.example: Hearing the bell, the boys [[tore]] down the hallway to be first in the lunch line.
senses.example_zh: 一聽到鐘聲，男孩們就沿著走廊飛奔，想搶在午餐隊伍的最前面。

senses.en: to make someone unable to choose between two things
senses.pattern: be torn between A and B / torn between two choices / feel torn
senses.example: She was [[torn]] between studying abroad and staying home to look after her sick mother.
senses.example_zh: 她在出國留學和留在家照顧生病的母親之間左右為難。

senses.en: to be much taller or better than others
senses.pattern: tower over / tower above / tower over one's classmates
senses.example: Ancient redwood trees [[tower]] over the visitors walking along the forest trail.
senses.example_zh: 古老的紅杉高聳於森林步道上的遊客頭頂。

senses.en: to disturb a plan, balance, or normal situation
senses.pattern: upset the balance / upset one's plans / upset one's routine
senses.example: The sudden rain [[upset]] our plans for a barbecue by the lake.
senses.example_zh: 突如其來的雨打亂了我們在湖邊烤肉的計畫。

senses.en: a surprising result in which the favorite loses
senses.pattern: a major upset / pull off an upset / the biggest upset of the season
senses.example: In the biggest [[upset]] of the tournament, the unknown school team beat last year's champions.
senses.example_zh: 這次錦標賽爆出最大冷門：沒沒無聞的校隊擊敗了去年的冠軍。

gsat.sentence: Sea life can get sucked into desalination plants, killing small ocean creatures like baby fish and plankton, [[upsetting]] the food chain.

senses.en: to a great extent; by a long way
senses.pattern: well over an hour / well before sunrise / well ahead of schedule / well past midnight
senses.example: The concert ended [[well]] past midnight, so we had to take a taxi home.
senses.example_zh: 演唱會結束時早已遠遠過了午夜，我們只好搭計程車回家。
senses.note: 放在介系詞或副詞前加強語氣

senses.en: a deep hole in the ground for water or oil
senses.pattern: dig a well / an oil well / draw water from a well
senses.example: Villagers used to walk two kilometers every day to fetch water from the [[well]].
senses.example_zh: 村民以前每天要走兩公里到井邊打水。

senses.en: (of liquid or feeling) to rise to the surface
senses.pattern: tears well up / well up in one's eyes / anger wells up
senses.example: Tears [[welled]] up in her eyes as she read the letter from her late grandmother.
senses.example_zh: 她讀著已故祖母寫的信，淚水不禁湧出。
senses.note: 常與 up 連用：well up

gsat.sentence: At that point, it might be [[well]] past the best moment to take in fluid.

quiz.stem: After the powerful earthquake, rescue teams ______ the ruins of the apartment building for two days, hoping to find survivors trapped underneath.
quiz.explain_zh: comb＝仔細搜尋。救難隊在公寓廢墟中徹底搜尋受困的生還者。

quiz.stem: In dim light, the ______ of our eyes grow larger so that more light can enter and help us see more clearly.
quiz.explain_zh: pupil＝瞳孔。光線昏暗時瞳孔會放大，讓更多光線進入眼睛。

quiz.stem: A ______ society, the speaker argued, is one in which all children, rich or poor, have an equal chance to receive a good education.
quiz.explain_zh: just＝公正的。講者主張公正的社會應讓所有孩子都有平等的受教機會。

quiz.stem: Standing nearly 500 meters tall, the new skyscraper ______ over every other building in the city and can be seen from miles away.
quiz.explain_zh: tower＝高聳、遠高於。新摩天大樓比市內其他建築都高出許多。

quiz.stem: Before moving into the apartment, the couple had to pay a ______ equal to two months' rent, which would be returned when they moved out.
quiz.explain_zh: deposit＝押金。入住前須先付相當於兩個月房租的押金，搬走時退還。

quiz.stem: The pop singer's sudden announcement that she would retire at the height of her career caused quite a ______ among fans around the world.
quiz.explain_zh: stir＝騷動、轟動。歌手在事業巔峰突然宣布退休，引起全球歌迷轟動。

quiz.stem: Having joined the newspaper only a month ago, the young reporter was still ______ and often needed advice from senior colleagues on how to conduct interviews.
quiz.explain_zh: green＝無經驗的、生嫩的。記者才入行一個月，採訪還常需前輩指點。

quiz.stem: The dark clouds gathering over the mountains and the sudden drop in temperature ______ that a storm is on its way.
quiz.explain_zh: suggest＝顯示、暗示。山上的烏雲和氣溫驟降顯示暴風雨即將來臨。

quiz.stem: Although the two writers lived in different countries and rarely met in person, their friendship ______ for more than fifty years through letters.
quiz.explain_zh: endure＝持續、持久。兩位作家雖少見面，友誼卻靠書信持續了五十多年。

quiz.stem: All first-year students are required to attend a two-day ______ before the semester begins, where they learn about school rules and meet their new classmates.
quiz.explain_zh: orientation＝新生訓練。大一新生開學前須參加兩天的新生訓練。
